Hello! I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer — it's yours, and everything I do happens here on it.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Messengers** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, plus my own Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **Accounts & passwords** — I can create my own accounts on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Also** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I've also got your identity sheet and the calendar for next week loaded from `files/CALENDAR.md` (working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00), and alvarez-agent is connected here too.

What would you like to start with?

Hello — I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I keep Professor Alvarez's calendar and messages, and I'm your agent for anything on this machine.

From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Chat and calls** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, plus my own Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?

- **Jobs and more** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.
